items.name: Unbroken Focus
items.description: Your concentration cannot be broken by minor distractions. Additional homebrew rules are resolved manually.

items.name: Memory Surge
items.description: As a bonus action, you release stored memories, dealing psychic damage to a creature. This maneuver is a homebrew example.

items.name: Glowing Ember
items.description: A spark leaps toward a creature. On a failed Dexterity saving throw, it takes fire damage. This spell is for importer testing only.

items.name: Forgekeeper's Blade
items.description: A custom one-handed blade used to verify the Foundry attack activity.

items.name: Traveler's Mantle
items.description: A simple protective traveling cloak. No automatic armor changes are included in this sample.
